description: This Java class 'NormalizedMessageMapper' implements message mapping for normalized changes within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It processes 'create' and 'modify' events into nested JSON structures, while dropping other messages. It includes configuration, mapping logic, and helper methods for JSON construction.

classes.name: NormalizedMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class implementing message mapping for normalized changes, converting create and modify events into nested JSON structures.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this mapper, which is 'normalized'.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided mapping and message configuration, setting up JSON field selection based on 'fields' property.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Drops all incoming external messages, returning an empty list.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps adaptable objects to external messages if they represent created or modified thing events; otherwise returns empty list.

methods.name: flattenAsThingChange
methods.description: Converts an adaptable representing a create or modify event into an ExternalMessage with nested JSON payload.

methods.name: abridgeMessage
methods.description: Creates a JSON object summarizing the message, excluding 'value' and 'status' fields.

methods.name: dittoHeadersToJson
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders to a JSON object.

methods.name: isCreatedOrModifiedThingEvent
methods.description: Checks if a topic path corresponds to a create or modify thing event.
